rootCause: The repository tree at HEAD contains a single entry with mode 160000 (gitlink/submodule) at path './' pointing to commit 1545101fb54b22287b801e715aed3a67100a7c9c. This is a self-referencing gitlink — the repo's own tree points to itself as a submodule at the root path './'. No actual source files (backend/, expo/, docs/, etc.) exist as tree entries. The github_commit_multi_file API creates blobs and commits but constructs the tree incorrectly — it embeds a gitlink entry at path './' instead of creating proper tree entries for each file/directory. This means every commit in the 1,827-commit history has the same broken structure: a tree with one gitlink entry and zero files.
recoveryMethod: The existing commit history cannot be repaired incrementally because every tree is broken. Recovery requires: (1) Create a fresh git repository with proper file trees. (2) Copy all source files from the workspace. (3) Create a clean initial commit with a proper tree containing all files as blob entries (not gitlinks). (4) Force-push to GitHub to replace the broken history. The Rork-managed git router or the github_commit_multi_file API (with fixed tree creation) can be used for the push.
